caption:
The dua Ibrahim made for knowledge and good company

Ibrahim asked his Lord for knowledge, to be joined with the righteous, for an honorable mention among later generations, and to be among those who inherit the Garden of Bliss. A beautiful dua to carry into Friday.

Surah Ash-Shu'araa 26:83-85

Which of these four requests will you add to your dua tonight?

#prophetibrahim #duaforknowledge #surahshuara #jumuah

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
